_meta.purpose: Absorbed evidence ledger for former planning-closure status claims. After masterplan v2 Sub-AC 1, this ledger is provenance only; live work-item IDs and status claims resolve through /specs/masterplan.json#masterplan_v2.

closure_scope.gate_command: oya-ci-required cloud-ci planning-closure Rust gate packet
closure_scope.gate_command_authority_note: destination authority per the founder all-CLI-retirement directive of 2026-06-09; legacy oya-dev-cli planning-closure validation is provenance-only migration input and is never merge or exit authority

authoritative_selection_inputs: plain git protected PR plus oya-ci-required/cloud-ci admission state
current_claim_alignment.historical_snapshot_rule: Historical implementation-index snapshots are provenance-only and cannot by themselves create a current FD-001 ChangeSet claim.
current_claim_alignment.closed_planning_status_rule: A planning-closed status is claimable only after /specs/masterplan.json carries the live MPV2 work item with evidence refs and the protected PR plus oya-ci-required/cloud-ci boundary is green.
current_claim_alignment.fanout_guard: Shared API/data/policy/evidence/path writes remain serialized until their contract claims and chained-enforcement gates are green.

closure_rule: A closed planning status means the implementation contract is authored, sequenced, evidence-gated, and claimable through plain git protected PRs plus oya-ci-required/cloud-ci authority. Oya VCS references are future-target/provenance-only for planning closure and are not merge or closure authority. It does not mean product code is already implemented or that exit evidence may be claimed without the listed gates.
implementation_guardrails: Every closed planning item remains a ChangeSet-owned execution unit.
Implementation begins only after the planning-closure gate is green.
A status closure must cite this ledger and the planning-closure contract.

No production, hyperscaler-grade, or industry-leading claim is valid until the corresponding implementation evidence, tests, observability, auditability, policy, performance, security, deployment, rollback, and operations gates pass.
Documents that still contain stale planning placeholders must either be updated to current closure evidence or archived under the planning-closure stale-document archive.

Historical implementation-index snapshots are provenance-only; current ChangeSet selection must use current source inspection, plain git protected PR state, runtime plan-tree scans, and the master-plan sequencing select-next-ready step.
A completed compatibility lane must not be re-opened as FD-001 product implementation unless current protected PR/cloud-ci admission names a fresh ChangeSet boundary.
